name: Ro Carlucci
tribute: Ro compiled 400 wins and three FCIAC titles as Westhill High School's gymnastics coach, was one of the sport's top judges, and is a member of the FCIAC Hall of Fame. She was a distinguished teacher who used her battle with breast cancer as a way to reaffirm her status as a role model. As she once said, 'I always found it better to leave a place better than you found it.'
